errors.description: Incorrect setup for repeated factors: denominator (x-1)^2 written as A/(x-1) instead of A/(x-1) + B/(x-1)^2
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Repeated linear factor (x-r)^k requires k partial fractions: A_1/(x-r) + A_2/(x-r)^2 + ... + A_k/(x-r)^k

errors.description: Used Heaviside cover-up method on irreducible quadratic factors where it does not directly apply
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Heaviside cover-up is only valid for non-repeated linear factors. For quadratics (x^2+bx+c), use polynomial coefficient equating.

errors.description: Forgot negative sign when converting -3 + j4 into polar form; quadrant angle returned -53.1° instead of 126.9°
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: When real part is negative (Quadrant II or III), angle is 180° - arctan(|y/x|) or 180° + arctan(|y/x|)

errors.description: Multiplication by j: miscalculated j^3 as +j instead of -j
Flipped numerator and denominator in change-of-base rule: log_b(a) = ln(b)/ln(a) instead of ln(a)/ln(b)
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: log_b(a) = log_c(a) / log_c(b) -> "base goes to the basement / bottom"

errors.description: Mistook power gain dB formula 10*log(P2/P1) for voltage gain 20*log(V2/V1)
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Power: 10*log10(P2/P1) dB. Voltage/Current: 20*log10(V2/V1) dB across equal impedances.

errors.description: Applied infinite sum formula without testing |r| < 1 condition when common ratio r = 1.25
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Sum exists if and only if |r| < 1. If |r| >= 1, the geometric series diverges.

errors.description: In geometric series sum formula S = a / (1 - r), substituted r instead of (1-r)
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Sum of infinite geometric series |r| < 1 is S_inf = a1 / (1 - r)

errors.description: Sign checkerboard cofactor error in calculating 3x3 determinant row expansion (+ - +)
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Cofactor sign is (-1)^(i+j). For row 1: (+, -, +). For row 2: (-, +, -).

errors.description: Question asked for product of roots (c/a), but calculated sum of roots (-b/a)
Failed to flip inequality sign when dividing both sides by a negative coefficient (-3x > 9 -> x > -3 instead of x < -3)
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Multiplying or dividing by a negative number reverses the inequality direction.

errors.description: Added work times directly instead of adding individual work rates (1/t1 + 1/t2 = 1/t_total)
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Work rate formula: Rate = Work / Time. Combined work: Rate_A + Rate_B = 1/T_combined.

errors.description: Missed extraneous root resulting from squaring both sides of radical equation in system
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Always verify solutions in the original un-squared radical equation to discard extraneous roots.

errors.description: Confused inverse variation y = k/x with joint variation y = k*x*z
errors.solutionOrKeyFormula: Direct: y = k*x. Inverse: y = k/x. Joint: y = k*x*z. Combined: y = k*x/z.
